context.disclaimer: Every league, team, player, analyst, statistic and report in this corpus is invented for the Ask Pivot research sandbox. None of it describes a real NBA player, team, contract or game. It must never be mixed with Pivot's NBA data.

priority_dimensions.label: Point-of-attack defense
priority_dimensions.description: Containing the ball handler at the start of a possession: staying in front, navigating screens, pressuring without fouling.

priority_dimensions.label: Wing / positional defense
priority_dimensions.description: Guarding bigger wings one-on-one and switching across positions.

priority_dimensions.label: Team / help defense
priority_dimensions.description: Rotations, help timing and communication — defending as part of five.

priority_dimensions.label: Spacing
priority_dimensions.description: Whether defenders must stay attached: shooting volume, willingness and gravity, not three-point percentage alone.

priority_dimensions.label: Secondary creation
priority_dimensions.description: Second-side playmaking, attacking closeouts and keeping the ball moving when the primary creator is denied.

priority_dimensions.label: Primary creation
priority_dimensions.description: Running the offense: pick-and-roll reads, collapsing the defense, creating for others.

priority_dimensions.label: Rim protection
priority_dimensions.description: Deterring and contesting shots at the basket.

priority_dimensions.label: Rebounding
priority_dimensions.description: Finishing possessions on the defensive glass and creating extra ones on offense.

priority_dimensions.label: Youth / development upside
priority_dimensions.description: Age and the room a player has left to improve.

priority_dimensions.label: Availability
priority_dimensions.description: Games played and durability across the season.
